claims.text: Takeda is migrating from SAP ECC to SAP Cloud ERP via RISE with SAP as part of a broader digital transformation.
Takeda is a large, global life‑sciences company (scale driving complexity and regulatory needs).
Takeda describes SAP as the core system running manufacturing, supply chain, finance, quality and more.
Takeda and SAP are co‑developing agentic AI functionalities targeted at regulated industries.
Takeda’s priorities include completing the S/4HANA journey and using AI capabilities in SAP Cloud ERP.

evidence.quote: The biotech company’s move from SAP ERP Central Component (SAP ECC) to SAP Cloud ERP applications through the RISE with SAP journey is part of a broader effort to simplify how its business runs, make better use of data, and create more room for digital and AI-enabled ways of working.
Takeda has 250 years of history, 50,000 employees, global operations, and medicines reaching patients in more than 80 countries.
SAP is the core system that supports and operates nearly all of our processes around the globe, from manufacturing and supply chain to finance, quality, and beyond.
“Together, we are co-developing new agentic functionalities for regulated industries,” Straub said. “We believe these capabilities can scale across the industry, not just within Takeda.”

Looking ahead, Straub said the priorities are clear: bring the SAP S/4HANA journey to life, understand and use the AI capabilities in SAP Cloud ERP effectively, and continue building the partnership with SAP.
